report:
Feature: Start makes the locomotives drive
Expected: Both histories contain entries with a speed higher than the calibration speed (the train's normal speed), forward or backward; at least one train currently has a speed greater than 0; apart from the calibration speed, each train uses only one non-zero speed value
Observed failure: After Start the badge showed 'In Fahrt' and both trains 'fährt nach Haltestelle 1', but after 15 s Bahn 2 still showed speed 0 at Block LA 0 cm and its distance since calibration was unchanged; in the mock console both trains have Speed 0 and the newest log entry predates the Start click - no speed commands were sent after Start. Histories only contain normal speeds from before this test.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Train positions move live in the preview
Expected: At least one train marker is at a clearly different place on the track in the second screenshot
Observed failure: After Start the badge showed 'In Fahrt' and the legend 'Bahn 1: fährt nach Haltestelle 1'/'weicht aus', 'Bahn 2: fährt nach Haltestelle 1', but two screenshots 3 s apart were identical: the 'Bahn 2' marker stayed on the upper-left straight left of Haltestelle 1, no 'Bahn 1' marker was visible in either screenshot (although a 'Bahn 1' label exists in the accessibility tree); Bahn 2 status stayed 'Geschwindigkeit 0 (rückwärts)', 'Block LA, 0 cm'. No train moved after Start.
Steps completed before failure: 12

Feature: Switches are set while driving
Expected: After Start, new switch changes have been added to the history of 'Weichen', i.e. the app has set switches via the Switch Server while the trains were driving
Observed failure: The 'Applied switch changes' column of 'Weichen' before Start read '#2: 1 → 2, #1: 1 → 2, #1: 2 → 1, #0: 1 → 2, #1: 1 → 2, #1: 2 → 1' (applied 5). After Stop, reset, stops Bahn 1 = Haltestelle 1/2, Bahn 2 = Haltestelle 2/1, Start and 2 x 30 s wait, the column was unchanged: no new entries, still applied 5, positions #0:2 #1:1 #2:2 #3:1. The app set no switches after Start.
Steps completed before failure: 13

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: After Stop, reset, stops Bahn 1 = Haltestelle 1/2 and Bahn 2 = Haltestelle 2/1 and Start, all 4 views of the track graphic (8 s apart) showed only one visible marker 'Bahn 2' on the upper-left curve near Haltestelle 1; the accessibility snapshot placed the 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' labels at exactly the same box (171,315,44,17), i.e. the markers lie on top of each other. Neither moved during the run; legend said 'Bahn 1: fährt nach Haltestelle 1'/'weicht aus', 'Bahn 2: fährt nach Haltestelle 2'.
Steps completed before failure: 8

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: After Stop, reset, stops Bahn 1 = A Haltestelle 1, B Haltestelle 2, Bahn 2 = A, B and Start (badge 'In Fahrt'), neither train moved during ~90 s: screenshots at 0/25/30/60 s show Bahn 2 on the top straight just left of Haltestelle 1, Bahn 1's marker not visible; legend 'Bahn 1: weicht aus', 'Bahn 2: fährt nach Haltestelle 1' throughout; status Bahn 1 0 cm/s Block T1 150 cm, Bahn 2 0 cm/s Block LA 0 cm. Bahn 1 never reached A; the trains seem to block each other.
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Recalibration during operation
Expected: For at least one train the history shows, after entries with its normal speed, a new entry with the low calibration speed, followed later by its normal speed again: the train was recalibrated at the calibration point during operation and then continued driving
Observed failure: After Stop, reset, two stops each (Haltestelle 1/2) and Start, both trains stayed at speed 0; their 'Applied speed changes' did not change after Start (Bahn 1: '60 forward → 0 forward → 120 backward → 0 backward → 120 forward → 0 forward → 120 forward → 0 forward → 120 forward → 0 forward', Bahn 2: '60 forward → 0 forward → 110 backward → 0 backward'), applied counts unchanged (10 / 4). No calibration-speed entry during operation.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: Switch server becomes reachable again
Expected: The mock console shows at least 1 connected client for 'Weichen'; in the app the switches are no longer red and there is no error message about 'Weichen'
Observed failure: After taking Weichen offline the app showed "Server 'Weichen' ist nicht erreichbar." and all switches 'keine Verbindung'. After 'Bring Weichen online' and a 15 s wait the console showed Weichen 'Online' but 'Connected clients' 0 (app had not reconnected in those 15 s). After reopening the app URL the alert was gone and the switches showed 'gerade' in neutral grey; only after that page load did the console show 1 connected client. Step 10 (connected client check) failed.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: Locomotive server becomes reachable again
Expected: The mock console shows at least 1 connected client for 'Bahn 2', and the app shows the connection to 'Bahn 2' again without an error message about 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: After 'Take Bahn 2 offline' the app correctly showed "Server 'Bahn 2' ist nicht erreichbar." and 'Keine Verbindung'. After 'Bring Bahn 2 online' and a 15 s wait, the console listed Bahn 2 Online but with 0 connected clients (step 10). Only after reopening the app URL did the app show Bahn 2 'Verbunden' without error, and a later console check showed 1 connected client.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: After clicking 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' and waiting 20 s, the dialog still showed 'Schritt 1 von 2' with 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert und fährt anschließend zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt. Bitte warten …'; Bahn 1 still showed position unknown and speed 0. Only after ~40 s in total did the dialog show 'Schritt 2 von 2' / 'Bitte stellen Sie Bahn 2 auf den Kalibrierpunkt'. The feature works but took longer than the 20 s allowed.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: After clicking 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' and waiting 20 s, the dialog still read 'Schritt 1 von 2' / 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert und fährt anschließend zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt. Bitte warten …' with no prompt for Bahn 2; the Control Panel showed Bahn 1 speed '60 (0 cm/s, vorwärts)' and position 'unbekannt' - the page looked stuck.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Clicking 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' started the calibration (dialog: 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert und fährt anschließend zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt. Bitte warten …', Bahn 1 speed 60). After the 20 s wait the dialog still showed 'Schritt 1 von 2' with the waiting text, no Bahn 2 prompt. Only after ~40 s in total did it show 'Schritt 2 von 2 · Bitte stellen Sie Bahn 2 auf den Kalibrierpunkt' with button 'Bahn 2 steht am Kalibrierpunkt'. Works, but slower than the 20 s allowed.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled
Observed failure: In tab 2, after clicking 'Bahn 2 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' and waiting 20 s, the snapshot still showed the dialog with 'Bahn 2 wird kalibriert. Bitte warten …' and Start / 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' disabled. Tab 1 (not reloaded) showed the dialog gone, 'Alle Bahnen sind kalibriert. …' and Start enabled. Only when switching back to tab 2 a few seconds later did it show the completed state with Start enabled. Sync across frontends works, but the confirming tab still showed the dialog when it was read.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: After clicking 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' and waiting 20 s, the dialog still showed 'Schritt 1 von 2' / 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert und fährt anschließend zum Kalibrier-Wartepunkt. Bitte warten …' and did not ask for Bahn 2, although Bahn 1 had already stopped ('Bahn 1: steht', speed 0, Block BR 30 cm, 260 cm since calibration). After 15 s more nothing changed - the dialog appears stuck at step 1.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled
Observed failure: In tab 2, after clicking 'Bahn 2 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' and waiting 20 s, Start was enabled and the status 'Alle Bahnen sind kalibriert' was shown, but the dialog 'Ersteinrichtung: Bahnen kalibrieren' with 'Bahn 2 wird kalibriert. Bitte warten …' was still open. Tab 1 (not reloaded) was correct: dialog gone, Start enabled. The confirming tab never closed its own dialog.
Steps completed before failure: 5
